choices.en: wukong was scared of the demon.
the travelers couldn't cross the river.
chen had to give his son to the demon.
choices.zh: 陈不得不把他的儿子交给恶魔。

answer_evidence.quote: "How will we cross this river?" said the Tang Monk.
"It's so wide, I can't see the other side."

"It's just that life is very bad in this village. A few years ago, a terrible demon arrived. He's always treated us badly, but now things are worse. He demanded that we give him a child. If we don't, he'll destroy our entire village. Tomorrow morning I must . . . hand over my son!"
"I'm not laughing at you, sir. I'm laughing because today is the luckiest day of your life."
"But I am Sun Wukong, the Monkey King. I once defeated the Jade Emperor's entire army. And tomorrow I will save your son's life."

answer_evidence.quote: A few villagers peeked out of windows and from behind doors.

"Why does everyone in this village seem so scared?" asked the Tang Monk.
